description: THE REGULAR USER ON THE SHIPPED TABLE: THE ONLY CONFIGURATION IN WHICH THE AUTHORISATION FILTER'S FIRST CONJUNCT IS TRUE. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY dispatching the mid-table option 05 for a regular user: CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'U' arrives in the communication area with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT already 1, so app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:87 takes the ELSE, line 92 receives the map, and the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER at line 94 - gate G30. Lines 117-121 scan OPTIONI PIC X(2) (app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132) from the right and stop at WS-IDX 2 because byte two is '5'; line 122 moves both bytes into WS-OPTION-X PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT (line 45), line 123 finds no space to INSPECT away, line 124 leaves WS-OPTION at 05 and line 125 echoes '05' into OPTIONO. The three-term guard at 127-129 is false on every term - 05 is numeric, 05 is not greater than the CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT of 10 at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21, and 05 is not zero - so no 'Please enter a valid option number...' is composed and WS-ERR-FLG stays as line 77 set it. WHAT THIS CASE EXISTS TO PROVE: the ungated filter at 136-137 is the one statement here that does real work, and this is the only case group that makes it earn its keep. 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:28) is TRUE for 'U', so the conjunction is NOT short-circuited by its first term the way case03 and case12 decide it; evaluation proceeds to the second term, CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(5), which app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:53 declares 'U', so = 'A' is FALSE and the conjunction is FALSE. The refusal body at 138-142 is therefore SKIPPED, and a regular user reaching a mid-table option navigates normally. Line 145 finds the flag still OFF, line 146 finds COCRDUPC's leading five bytes to be 'COCRD' and not 'DUMMY', and lines 147, 148 and 151 set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to 'CM00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to 'COMEN01C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back to 0 before the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area to CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(5), which app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:52 declares COCRDUPC PIC X(08) - gate G40. Lines 149 and 150 are COMMENTED OUT, so CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE cross unchanged and 'U' is still 'U' on the way out; nothing here writes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which only the PF3 arm at 97 and the signon default at 173 do, so it leaves holding the COMEN01C it arrived with. WHAT MAKES THIS DISTINCT: case04 walks the same regular user through option 01, so it decides the filter on the FIRST slot and would still pass an implementation that special-cased the head of the table; case11 and case10 reach the refusal itself, but only against a stub table, because the shipped one cannot produce it; case19 repeats option 06 three times to prove statelessness rather than to pin the filter; and case17 admits an unrecognised user type, for which the 88 is false and the second term is never consulted. Only a 'U' caller on a genuinely mid-table slot puts the first conjunct in the TRUE state and leaves the SECOND term as the sole reason the refusal declines - so this expectation is the one that fails if a translation inverts the = 'A' test, compares the column for a MATCH against the caller's type, hard-codes an option as admin-only, or repairs a USRTYPE column to 'A' the way the commented-out variant at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:69 invites. THE USER-TYPE COLUMN IS A VERIFIED FACT, NOT A DEFECT TO FIX: CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE is PIC X(01) per entry (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:92) and ALL TEN valued entries carry 'U' - at :29, :35, :41, :47, :53, :59, :65, :72, :78 and :84 - so not one carries 'A' and the filter's second term can never be true for an in-range populated subscript. The 'No access - Admin Only option... ' path is thus unreachable with the shipped table and stays preserved dead code, neither wired up nor removed. Were 138-142 reached, WS-MESSAGE would hold that thirty-three-character literal from line 140 - note the trailing space INSIDE the literal - right-padded with spaces to eighty; that image is asserted ABSENT. THE FALL-THROUGH TRAP is the second decisive assertion: an EXEC CICS XCTL never returns, so lines 157-164 do not execute and neither the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at 158 nor the STRING at 159-163 happens. Were they reached, that STRING would send 'This option ' DELIMITED BY SIZE, then CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(5) DELIMITED BY SPACE - which stops at the first space of the thirty-five-byte 'Credit Card Update                 ' literal at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:51 and yields the one token Credit - then 'is coming soon ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE, composing the byte-exact This option Creditis coming soon ... with NO space before is. That image is asserted ABSENT too: expectedMessages carries the eighty-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 exactly as the SPACES of line 79 left it, so a translation that fell out of the transfer into the coming-soon block fails on the message and on the colour at once. Every message this program can write - lines 101, 131, 140 and 159-163 - is therefore asserted absent here, and no validation text, no thank-you text (the source contains none) and no invalid-key text appears either. ALSO PINNED, and consistent with case03 and case04: sends is empty, no mapset or map is named, and none of the twelve OPTN00nO option lines is composed - because MAP('COMEN1A') and MAPSET('COMEN01') at 190-191 and the PERFORM BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 185 all sit inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN (182-194), which a transfer never performs, and BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 236-277 is reached only from there. Naming this screen on a transfer would tell the client to paint the screen the program is leaving, which is the one answer that is certainly wrong; the successor travels as a response field with the whole conversation in the payload, and there is no server-side forward and no session state - gates G40 and G37. ERRMSGC keeps the mapset's declared COLOR=RED because line 158 is unreached, and no DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight appears in this folder at all, because COMEN01C copies no CSSETATY - its sole consumer is app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl - so gate G38 is honoured here through the ENTER/REENTER split rather than through a highlight: this is a REENTER-side case that nonetheless emits no error output. CDEMO-USER-TYPE is trusted exactly as it arrives and is never re-read from USRSEC, re-verified or hashed, because line 150 is commented out and the single X(01) comparison at 137 is the whole authorisation mechanism; nothing is added to it. The unit is admin.MainMenuService driven directly, with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher - gate G51; inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because COMEN01C declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file verb, so gates G19, G21 and G47 have no subject; expectedReturnCode is 0 because an online transaction sets none, and there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and no GO TO anywhere in the program. The clock is pinned to the 2022-07-19T23:12:33 of the version footer at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:281, the same instant every case in this folder pins, so FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at line 214 can never make a run depend on the wall clock. Every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybooks and the BMS definitions and was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution - no such runtime exists in this environment, per the eight verified blockers recorded in 0.7.6 of the plan (risk R-A).
